The proposed strategy replaces this with a **smooth differentiable penalty** based on the maximum support function of the Minkowski difference of the hexagons. This allows the optimizer to "feel" the repulsion between hexagons even when they are not strictly overlapping, guiding them into valid configurations more effectively.
